### Literature
- The **BL** listed below are problem numbers from the course book Villani (2025a). [Bayesian Learning](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesianLearningBook/raw/main/pdf/BayesBook.pdf).
- The **BLprequel** listed below are problem numbers from a book [Bayesian Learning - the prequel](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesianLearningBook/raw/main/pdf/PreBayesBook.pdf).
- The **BDA** listed below are problem numbers from the course book Gelman, Carlin, Stern, Dunson, Vehtari, Rubin (2014). [Bayesian Data Analysis](http://www.stat.columbia.edu/~gelman/book/BDA3.pdf).


### Exercises

**Exercise 1 (preparatory) - Likelihood. Information. Basic Monte Carlo methods.**\
Problems: 1.1-1.4 in [Bayesian Learning exercises](exercises/BayesianLearningExercises.pdf)

**Exercise 2 - One-parameter models.**\
Problems: BL [2.1](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch2solutions.html#exercise-2.1), [2.2](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch2solutions.html#exercise-2.2), [2.3](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch2solutions.html#exercise-2.3), [2.4](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch2solutions.html#exercise-2.4), [2.5](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch2solutions.html#exercise-2.5), [2.7](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch2solutions.html#exercise-2.7)

**Exercise 3 - Multi-parameter models.**\
Problems: BL [2.12](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch2solutions.html#exercise-2.12), [3.1](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch3solutions.html#exercise-3.1), 3.2, [3.3](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch3solutions.html#exercise-3.3), [3.6](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch3solutions.html#exercise-3.6), [3.7](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch3solutions.html#exercise-3.7).

**Exercise 4 - Prior, Prediction and Decisions.**\
Problems: BL [4.3](https://mattiasvillani.com/BayesianLearningBook/exercises/ch4solutions.html#exercise-4.3) and TBA.
